g.text: Recommendation request — session and retrieval decisions
Parser and response chat models can differ.
Load session and run the transition.
Discard stale queue if search changed
Take pending recommendations, up to requested count
Build fresh batch, excluding shown IDs and cached tail
[Count, preference, history, help or unknown action]
Commit session if lock and version still match
Busy lock: 409. Lost lock or rejected commit: 503.
